mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, nickname, provider, provider_id, role, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{nickname}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_id = #{providerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = 'ACTIVE', updated_at = NOW() WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL
